summary.name: Espanso
summary.one_liner: Espanso is an open-source, cross-platform text expander that replaces typed keywords with snippets, dates, emojis, and command output as you type.
use_cases: Expanding frequently typed sentences and email templates
Inserting emojis and special characters via typed shortcuts
Inserting current date or past and future dates
Injecting terminal command output into applications
Filling reusable forms for customer support or sales replies
summary.what_it_does: Espanso detects when you type a keyword and replaces it with predefined text while you type. It supports snippets that can include dates, emojis, and math notation or accented characters via packages. Advanced snippets can run shell commands or custom scripts, and forms let users fill in values that can be passed to scripts. Configuration uses simple files following a Unix-like philosophy, and it can search snippets through an ALT+Space search bar. Packages can be installed from the Espanso Hub or created and shared by users.
notable: Open source under GPL-3 and hosted on GitHub
Snippets can run shell commands or custom scripts and inject output into apps
Forms for reusable templates with values passed to scripts
caveats: A GUI is planned for the future; configuration is currently via simple files
Stated goal of becoming a universal text expander is aspirational rather than a current feature
